#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class Main {
public:
    class Task {
    public:
        class Maxflow {
        public:
            struct Edge {
                int t, rev;
                long long cap, f;
                Edge(int t, int rev, long long cap): t(t), rev(rev), cap(cap), f(0) {}
            };

            vector<vector<Edge>> graph;

            Maxflow(int n): graph(n) {}

            void addEdge(int s, int t, long long cap) {
                graph[s].emplace_back(t, (int)graph[t].size(), cap);
                graph[t].emplace_back(s, (int)graph[s].size() - 1, 0);
            }

            bool dinicBFS(int src, int dest, vector<int>& dist) {
                fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), -1);
                dist[src] = 0;
                queue<int> Q;
                Q.push(src);
                while (!Q.empty()) {
                    int u = Q.front();
                    Q.pop();
                    for (auto &e: graph[u]) {
                        if (dist[e.t] < 0 && e.f < e.cap) {
                            dist[e.t] = dist[u] + 1;
                            Q.push(e.t);
                        }
                    }
                }
                return dist[dest] >= 0;
            }

            long long dinicDFS(vector<int>& ptr, vector<int>& dist, int dest, int u, long long f) {
                if (u == dest) return f;
                for (; ptr[u] < (int)graph[u].size(); ++ptr[u]) {
                    auto &e = graph[u][ptr[u]];
                    if (dist[e.t] == dist[u] + 1 && e.f < e.cap) {
                        long long df = dinicDFS(ptr, dist, dest, e.t, std::min(f, e.cap - e.f));
                        if (df > 0) {
                            e.f += df;
                            graph[e.t][e.rev].f -= df;
                            return df;
                        }
                    }
                }
                return 0;
            }

            long long maxFlow(int src, int dest) {
                long long flow = 0;
                vector<int> dist(graph.size());
                while (dinicBFS(src, dest, dist)) {
                    vector<int> ptr(graph.size(), 0);
                    while (true) {
                        long long df = dinicDFS(ptr, dist, dest, src, LLONG_MAX);
                        if (df == 0) break;
                        flow += df;
                    }
                }
                return flow;
            }
        };

        class MinCostFlowBF {
        public:
            struct Edge {
                int to, f, cap, cost, rev;
                Edge(int to, int cap, int cost, int rev): to(to), cap(cap), cost(cost), rev(rev), f(0) {}
            };

            vector<vector<Edge>> graph;

            MinCostFlowBF(int n): graph(n) {}

            void addEdge(int s, int t, int cap, int cost) {
                graph[s].emplace_back(t, cap, cost, (int)graph[t].size());
                graph[t].emplace_back(s, 0, -cost, (int)graph[s].size() - 1);
            }

            void bellmanFord(int s, vector<int>& dist, vector<int>& prevnode, vector<int>& prevedge, vector<int>& curflow) {
                int n = (int)graph.size();
                for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
                    dist[i] = INT_MAX;
                dist[s] = 0;
                curflow[s] = INT_MAX;
                vector<bool> inqueue(n, false);
                vector<int> q(n);
                int qt = 0;
                q[qt++] = s;
                for (int qh = 0; (qh - qt) % n != 0; ++qh) {
                    int u = q[qh % n];
                    inqueue[u] = false;
                    for (int i = 0; i < (int)graph[u].size(); ++i) {
                        auto &e = graph[u][i];
                        if (e.f >= e.cap) continue;
                        int v = e.to;
                        int ndist = dist[u] + e.cost;
                        if (dist[v] > ndist) {
                            dist[v] = ndist;
                            prevnode[v] = u;
                            prevedge[v] = i;
                            curflow[v] = std::min(curflow[u], e.cap - e.f);
                            if (!inqueue[v]) {
                                inqueue[v] = true;
                                q[qt++ % n] = v;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            tuple<int, int> minCostFlow(int s, int t, int maxf) {
                int n = (int)graph.size();
                vector<int> dist(n), curflow(n), prevedge(n), prevnode(n);
                int flow = 0, flowCost = 0;

                while (flow < maxf) {
                    bellmanFord(s, dist, prevnode, prevedge, curflow);
                    if (dist[t] == INT_MAX) break;
                    int df = std::min(curflow[t], maxf - flow);
                    flow += df;
                    for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevnode[v]) {
                        auto &e = graph[prevnode[v]][prevedge[v]];
                        e.f += df;
                        graph[v][e.rev].f -= df;
                        flowCost += df * e.cost;
                    }
                }
                return {flow, flowCost};
            }
        };

        void solve(istream &cin, ostream &cout) {
            int n, m, k, c, d;
            cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;
            vector<int> pos(n, 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
                int x; cin >> x;
                pos[x - 1]++;
            }

            const int T = 100;
            int totalNodes = (T + 1) * n + 2;
            MinCostFlowBF mf(totalNodes);

            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                if (pos[i] > 0)
                    mf.addEdge(0, i + 1, pos[i], 0);
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < T; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                    mf.addEdge(1 + i * n + j, 1 + (i + 1) * n + j, k, 0);
                }
            }

            for (int i = 0; i <= T; ++i) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= k; ++j) {
                    mf.addEdge(1 + i * n, (T + 1) * n + 1, 1, c * i);
                }
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
                int a, b; cin >> a >> b;
                --a; --b;
                for (int j = 0; j < T; ++j) {
                    int cost = 0;
                    for (int l = 1; l <= k; ++l) {
                        mf.addEdge(1 + j * n + a, 1 + (j + 1) * n + b, 1, l * l * d - cost);
                        mf.addEdge(1 + j * n + b, 1 + (j + 1) * n + a, 1, l * l * d - cost);
                        cost = l * l * d;
                    }
                }
            }

            auto flowAndCost = mf.minCostFlow(0, (T + 1) * n + 1, k);
            cout << flowAndCost.second << "\n";
        }
    };
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    Main::Task task;
    task.solve(cin, cout);
    return 0;
}
